title: Reconstruction of vertical alveolar ridge deficiencies utilizing a high -density polytetrafluoroethylene membrane /clinical impact of flap dehiscence on treatment outcomes: case series/
authors: Palkovics D, Bolya-Orosz F, Pinter C, Molnar B, Windisch P. BMC Oral Health. 2022 Nov 15;22(1):490. doi: 10.1186/s12903-022-02513-7.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “With the help of the currently reported 3D radiographic evaluation method, it can be concluded that exposure of the new-generation d-PTFE membrane had less negative impact on clinical results compared to literature data reporting on expanded polytetrafluoroethylene membranes” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
